requirements.label: Admin power is not a bare key
A confirmed delay before changes apply, no bypass
Bypass paths of the delay checked and ruled out
Price feed not under one hand

exit_window: a delay with a bypass, or one not ruled out

narrative.summary: Vault and strategy each sit behind a separate real TimelockController, both governed by the identical 3-of-6 Safe - the vault-level delay is 0, but the strategy-swap path (the highest-value action) carries a real 6h delay two ways over.
narrative.detail: The deployer’s own TIMELOCK_ADMIN_ROLE was revoked one block after deployment on both Timelocks - each self-administers now. Same Safe holds PROPOSER_ROLE and CANCELLER_ROLE on both, so there is no independent veto path, the same limitation already scored this way for this chain’s own L1 rollup authority.
